Completed the repository-wide caller-classification acceptance gap (2026-09-21): all 52 recorded legacy events/artist_events caller files are classified as 14 compatibility-gated and 38 deferred with named owners and contract rationales; the six canonical hot paths are the migrated callers and carry zero legacy reads. Exact counts reproduced by scan: 45 files with literal .from('events') reads + 14 files with literal .from('artist_events') reads, union 51 literal files, plus app/api/events/_lib/event-reference.ts (dynamic EVENT_REFERENCE_LOOKUP_ORDER) = 52.

Confirmed no clearly-safe in-scope gating change exists for any remaining caller: every remaining legacy caller sits outside the DB-006 working set, no caller whose identifier/authorization contract already matches events_v2 is in-scope-editable for this lane, and the six canonical paths contain zero legacy probes. No code change was made in this lane.

Recorded adjacent dynamic-table scan findings not captured by the literal 52-file inventory: lib/services/event-page.service.ts (dynamic EventTableName including artist_events/events; no active importer found; ARTIST cleanup review) and app/api/events/[id]/page/route.ts (DB-009 resolver-branched reader, covered by DB-009's 18-importer matrix).

events.start_date and events.cover_image_url are absent from BOTH the active chain and the generated types, so the product code reading them is reading columns the schema has never had. events.cover_image_url is read by app/artist/events/actions/marketing.ts and app/projects/page.tsx (entry-reachable). Canonical replacements recorded: events_v2 (DB-006's canonical table) and public.tours.cover_image_url, added by 20260720020302_admin_tour_stop_publish.sql.

event_posts is classified code-drift with conflictLiveConsumer=true: it has zero occurrences in the active chain and zero in the generated types, it exists only in out-of-chain SQL, and it is read by app/api/events/[id]/posts/route.ts and app/api/events/[id]/page/route.ts, both entry-reachable. This corroborates DB-006's earlier finding that no active creation/RLS migration exists for event_posts, and it is now recorded as a concrete object rather than an observation.

event_equipment, event_tasks, event_staff and event_crew_assignments are classified schema-missing or code-drift and routed in HF-DB008-SCHEMA-MISSING-ARTIST and HF-DB008-TYPECHECK-ARTIST. The first three are schema-missing with a live entry-reachable consumer (app/artist/events/actions/manage-equipment.ts, manage-tasks.ts, manage-staff.ts) and need the artist domain's column contract before a migration can be written; the database lane will not invent one.
